title: Serve European two-word initializer pairs
platforms: Windows tests under Wine, European ROM
changes: Add ten physical two-word initializer arrays and thirteen literal roots to the copied lookup resource, preserving shared addresses and previous Firaga ownership.
validation: Wine census x24m4_a0, Windows build bk4evfo2 and Wine xtp6kbf3 passed: thirteen original interpreter/generated readers, shared aliases, altered backing, 32-bit boundaries, full state and clock, preparation/reuse, exact e336 predecessor and transactional rejection; Wine drained.
limitations: The first Wine attempt qisp2u56 failed because its test expected a stop between chained adjacent generated blocks; the grouped retry passed. Ordinary entry, other formats, original BIOS, Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No performance measurements.
